variables.description: External host port for accessing the Particify audience response web interface.
variables.label: Particify Web Port

variables.description: Public hostname or domain for Particify (used for Nginx routing and JWT server ID, e.g. particify.example.com).
variables.label: Particify Hostname / Domain

variables.description: Public base URL of Particify including scheme (e.g. https://particify.example.com), used for activation and invitation links.
variables.label: Particify Public Root URL

variables.description: Enable anonymous guest access (true recommended with 'participant' role so audiences can vote without login).
variables.label: Allow Guest Access

variables.description: Roles permitted for guest accounts: 'participant' (Menti.com style: audience votes without login, moderators must register) or 'moderator,participant'.
variables.label: Guest Allowed Roles

variables.description: Display title for the built-in account login provider.
variables.label: Login Provider Title

variables.description: Comma-separated list of email domains allowed to register accounts (e.g. 'example.com' or '*' for all).
variables.label: Allowed Registration Email Domains

variables.description: Strong secret key (minimum 32 characters) used to sign authentication JWT tokens across Particify microservices. Change before production use.
variables.label: JWT Signing Secret

variables.description: Password securing Particify internal CouchDB and PostgreSQL (auth & comments) databases.
variables.label: Internal Database Password

variables.description: Optional Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors origins allowed to embed Particify (leave empty to disallow framing).
variables.label: CSP Frame Ancestors (Optional)

variables.description: Optional SMTP server hostname for sending account registration and password reset emails.
variables.label: SMTP Mail Host (Optional)

variables.description: Set to true for implicit TLS (port 465) or false for STARTTLS/plain.
variables.label: SMTP Implicit TLS

variables.description: Display name shown on outgoing Particify emails.
variables.label: Email Sender Name

variables.description: Sender email address for outgoing Particify emails.
variables.label: Email Sender Address
